dashboard.label: Better Map - Threat Map (MITRE)
dashboard.description: v1.6 showcase: ES-style threat map with MITRE ATT&CK enrichment. The map data source emits an attack_id field per event; the MITRE overlay decorates each feature with the technique name and tactics, and the ES-notable drilldown links each marker into Incident Review. Replace the inline SPL with your threat-intel + alerts.csv merge.
